_comment: Synthetic MEE6 export for TOG-3481. Every id is in the 90000000000000 reserved block that Discord never allocates, so nothing here is a real guild, member or role. The role_rewards list deliberately exercises every outcome in src/leveling/rewardImport.ts: two that map, and one of each skip reason. Paired with test/fixtures/mee6-guild-roles.json. If you change either file, update the other and the expected counts in test/unit.levelrewardimport.test.ts in the same commit.
